comments.value: I too notice that performance *seemed* worse - even when I reduced my resolution to 60%, my FOV by 50%, and culled every player it was worse than usual.

this sounds like the steam bug your fps will just take to near 11 for no reason and not recover. usually spam open and closeing your steam menu can sometimes fix it. have you tryed playing on it again after restarting steam

@{5f390f4a5b350629c88c2874|full_name}: in my case this was different from the FPS bug - my frame rate hovered around 30 instead of the usually 40-50.
Then again, this is all anecdotal. A proper benchmark might be in order? Maybe the heat was slowing our PCs down :p
Thanks for this, having a look.

This morning I was still in open beta and tried some worlds alone and was getting the full FPS cap of 91 on my machine. So potentially there is something blocking to wait for a network reply?
Usually at the meetups I get about 3-4 times better FPS.
@{59b15c3e62dfd809eb1144d3|full_name}: I'm on a walk but I would be glad to help later. System info in the OP. Desktop mode. It was too slow for me even to bother trying VR.

We're going to need some more detail-- our team is having problems reproducing.
In particular, can you reliably show reduced FPS between Live and Open Beta, with the same users/avatars in the same instance/world?

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: 
I totally understand. I'm a developer myself.
1) I never really have the kind of lag I had Sunday. This was the community meetup led by Cyanlaser, etc.
2) I would have to try again on the same code with 80 users.
3) as stated above my system load was low. System wasn't really doing much else. No reason for the performance to go down. Liquid cooled. Low temps throughout.
4) confounding the issue is that today I went to some worlds using open beta again alone and of course I maxed out the FPS. Everything was fine.
Could have been a fluke but the client should not wait to render frames, so slow it's down to 14FPS, just because of waiting for network updates. That would cause nausea in VR. It was hard enough in desktop.
Summary: 80 people, 1/3 the framerate, possibly less, Sunday open beta test, high pings so we could have been on a far away server.
Hope this helps.

@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: Out of curiosity, have you attended meetups in the past? They're usually quite laggy even on my fairly beefy system. 
That's unfortunately (for now) somewhat common for very high occupant-count instances in VRChat-- a consequence of many factors.
Notably,
> the client should not wait to render frames [...] because of waiting for network updates
The VRChat client doesn't do this. Framerate and network updates/latency/etc are completely detached.
> 80 people, 1/3 the framerate
1/3rd what framerate? The normal you'd expect from a 80-person instance?
We're still trying to reproduce the issue but aren't seeing anything out of the ordinary from our end just yet.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: 
Yes I visit the meetups every week.
1/3 (probably less) of the framerate I usually see in the same meetup world at the beginning of the meetup. Mostly the same users.
That's why I bothered to mention it. This is significantly different from my typical experience at the exact same room with the exact same users.
Meetup rules require medium or better avatar rating.
My system was very under utilized. It's not that. (As stated a few times now)
The Steam menu is smooth but Unity / VRChat is not. If I open the menu the steam overlay is smooth.
Hope that helps.
@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: Did anyone else report abnormally low framerates?

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: most people I talked to. I overheard maybe one or two who were having really good framerate.
Pretty much everyone else was having a slow experience that I knew of.
Hmm...

@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: Hm okay, but how in the world were you getting 91 fps ? I can't really imagine you having 91 FPS in a instance with 80 people in it. I mean I have a I7 8700k, 32 GB of RAM and a RTX 3070 and I would never get 91 fps in an instance with 80 people in it even in desktop as long as I don't hide all the avatars.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: From what I've been doing in the beta so far everything seemed fine for me in terms of performance.

@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: The best thing to do would probably be to open a world in live with 40 - 80 people that are all using some random avatars, and do the exact same thing in the beta, same world, same amount of people and the same avatars. And see which runs better for you, maybe also try to see if there are differences between the different regions, there shouldn't be any but just to be sure. And if there aren't any then there probably just was something wrong with the meetup idk.

@{5fca5df4d58780532024a52b|full_name}: I usually get 45-60fps in the main meetup area. I was getting 14. Thus: one third or less.
I don't have the clout to get 80+ people to join at the drop of a hat so I don't know how to pull that off other than having 80 test accounts...
91FPS is when I was alone.
(I know there is a lot of info here but I did state that clearly...)
I'm just one regular user who was attending the meetup world and they always suggest that if we encounter errors to write a canny.
So here we are.
If you're one of the devs you could probably reproduce it. Spin up that many test users into the community meetup world and compare.

@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: I'm not one of the developers, I’m just wondering why you had lower frame rates in the beta. I tested the beta a lot and my frame rate always seemed the same as in the live build.
Sorry for switching up the frame rate 40 – 50 seems reasonable if they all used medium or better avatars. I mean Tupper said they couldn’t reproduce it, that’s why I thought that maybe someone could have used an avatar that performed bad or maybe it’s specific to your pc setup. 
Btw were you using any mods? Cause they could also make problems especially in the beta version that they aren’t updated for.

@{5fca5df4d58780532024a52b|full_name}: zero mods ever.
I like running most programs and games with the defaults so I get the same experience everyone else does.
Anyway if you're not a dev, I am a busy person. I have to get back to paying work.
Thanks for your thoughts.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Okay, so I tried it with 10 local test clients and had the exact same frame rate in the beta and live build. So, works completely fine for me, maybe it was something that just effected that one meetup for him with people having worse performing avatars as last time or something like this.

Related: Did someone make a fix to the open beta because now I don't get any avatar pedestal transparent previews, but my home world is actually **faster** than before. The grass shader + the avatars usually made looking at them slower than 91FPS, but now they're 91FPS.
(See attached images)
I still don't know how to get 80 people in to do a comparison test until next Sunday but I thought you might find this new discovery interesting.

Turned Open Beta off (in normal release now) and it seems it's just as fast so I guess that's no difference from before. I just remember it being slightly slower before.
BUT: on the release / production version I see the avatar pedestal previews.

@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: it's known that the images on avatar pedestals aren't loading ^^
https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1104-avatar-pedestals-dont-display-image
And btw there was no fix, might just had something to do with that meetup and someone maybe using an not optimized avatar or so. ^^

We attempted to reproduce with a large group and detailed analytics and profiling, and were unable to reproduce. In fact, Open Beta seems to be performing better.
We were able to gather a good bit of data either way!
@{60785c18ba4ce0134a69cb24|full_name}: We haven't patched open beta since we initially launched it.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: 
I'm actually glad to hear that. Seeing as I haven't had any further issues, maybe it was temporary.
Feel free to close this.
Unable to reproduce.
Thanks to everyone who helped us try to repro this!
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: I'm both sorry and glad we were wrong! Can't wait to try out the regions on live 😤
@{5f8a26770aaa28611fedd6b6|full_name}: No worries! Better to be wrong after lots of checking than be right and not discover it until after we go Live.

details:
As soon as I downloaded the Open Beta for this week's community meetup my FPS took a drastic dive.
CPU usage: 20% - no cores at 100% (2700X)
RAM: 32 GB hardly any used up
GPU: 24% VRAM not full (2070)
Network: Usually my ping is 90 or better but it was over 200 or 300 depending on the region selected.
Overall performance was MUCH WORSE.
It was so bad I simply left the meetup. I could not play like that.
title: Severely reduced FPS as low as 14, usually 91
